name: Streamlit Trade (Python 3.11)
postCreateCommand: if [ -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/yarn.list ]; then sudo mv /etc/apt/sources.list.d/yarn.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d/yarn.list.disabled; fi && sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 update && tr -d '\r' < packages.txt | xargs -r sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 install -y --fix-missing && python -m pip install --user --index-url https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple --retries 10 --timeout 120 -r requirements.txt

postAttachCommand.server: python -m streamlit run app.py --server.address 0.0.0.0 --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false
